name: navan
description: Connect to Navan through its official MCP server.

research.notes: Navan's hosted MCP signs each user in with their own permissions; SSO companies need an admin to enable MCP first. Navan Business (companies up to 300 employees) is free with a self-serve sign-up by work email, Navan Expense is free for the first 5 users, and the MCP docs set no plan limit; only Navan Enterprise is quote-based. Navan Edge, a free product for solo business travellers, is not documented as working with the MCP. Discovery 2026-10-08: DCR yes (login.navan.com), CIMD no, token auth includes none, S256.

probe.reason: HTTP 401, sign-in methods and S256 PKCE confirmed; no account tested
